title: RPG Maker MV. Editor screen resolution

posts.author: Xploits
posts.body:
This image does not do it justice but this screenshot with context will hopefully be enough to have you understand and
hopefully help me.
Essentially i was using VX ace a whole bunch and just purchased MV however when I launch MV it's resolution looks like
a 2 year old's ipad. Extremely enlarged spread across my 3 monitors. Does anyone have any idea what is going on? i cant seem to find any information on this issue.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Please use the forum's functionality to attach pictures to your post (even if you have to resize them). I click on the Imgur link and nothing shows.
I can't tell from the thumbnail, have you clicked the Maximize button? That, by definition, should make it fill one screen.
